in_marathi.name: Laksh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Laksh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Lakshmana, the younger brother of Lord Rama, is the name origin. In Hindu mythology, he is known for his devotion and courage, symbolizing protection and prosperity. The name Laksh is derived from the Sanskrit word 'lakshya', which means 'goal' or 'target'.
